name: reporter_cluster_tables_handbook
description: Complete handbook test for Tables family reporters: summary_table (L1-L7), cs_summary_table (L1-L7), plus 3 CardRenderType layouts. 17 layouts total, each in its own category.
source:
# ========================================================================
# Tables Family Handbook — All Layouts
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

# === Core Derived Series ===
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
cum_ret = agg(daily_ret, AggregationType.Sum)
sma_20 = sma(close, 20)
sma_50 = sma(close, 50)
rsi_14 = rsi(close, 14)
ts = index()

# Date components (use ET timezone so midnight-UTC bars resolve to correct calendar date)
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)
dow = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)

# ========================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE (summary_table) — L1 through L7
# ========================================================================

# L1: Simple 1x1 grid — single metric
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='01 summary_table L1: Simple Grid',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Last Close Price',
      row_size=1, col_size=1,
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(close)

# L2: 2x2 grid — mixed aggregations
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='02 summary_table L2: Mixed Aggs',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Return & Volume Stats',
      row_size=2, col_size=2,
      row_headers=['Return', 'Volume'],
      col_headers=['Mean', 'Sum'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]))
(daily_ret, daily_ret, volume, volume)

# L3: 2x3 grid — row and column headers
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='03 summary_table L3: Row Col Headers',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Price Statistics',
      row_size=2, col_size=3,
      row_headers=['Price', 'SMA 20'],
      col_headers=['Mean', 'Min', 'Max'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(close, close, close, sma_20, sma_20, sma_20)

# L4: PercentFormat with info tooltips
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='04 summary_table L4: Percent Format',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Return Metrics',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['Mean Return', 'Cumulative', 'Last RSI'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                   info='Average daily return over period'),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                   info='Cumulative return'),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1,
                   info='Relative Strength Index (14-period)')
      ]))
(daily_ret, cum_ret, rsi_14)

# L5: Direct color on cells
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='05 summary_table L5: Direct Color',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Performance Summary',
      row_size=2, col_size=2,
      row_headers=['Daily', 'Period'],
      col_headers=['Return', 'RSI'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                   grid_color=Color.Green),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1,
                   grid_color=Color.Blue),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                   grid_color=Color.Red),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]))
(daily_ret, rsi_14, daily_ret, rsi_14)

# L6: RowSpec GROUP BY — Daily return stats by month
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    category='06 summary_table L6: RowSpec Monthly',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Daily Return Stats by Month',
      col_headers=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'],
      rows=[
        RowSpec(name='Average', agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        RowSpec(name='Best', agg=AggregationType.Max,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        RowSpec(name='Worst', agg=AggregationType.Min,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        RowSpec(name='Count', agg=AggregationType.Count,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]))
(daily_ret, month_num)

# L7: RowSpec with direct color — Day-of-week stats
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    category='07 summary_table L7: RowSpec Color',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Day-of-Week Return Stats',
      col_headers=['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri'],
      rows=[
        RowSpec(name='Avg Return', agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3,
                color=Color.Blue),
        RowSpec(name='Median', agg=AggregationType.Median,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3,
                color=Color.Indigo),
        RowSpec(name='Observations', agg=AggregationType.Count,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]))
(daily_ret, dow)

# ========================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL SUMMARY TABLE (cs_summary_table) — L1 through L7
# ========================================================================

# L1: Basic with schema — column titles defined
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        TableReportColumn(title='Close'),
        TableReportColumn(title='RSI 14'),
        TableReportColumn(title='SMA 20')
      ]),
    category='08 cs_summary_table L1: Basic Schema')
(close, rsi_14, sma_20)

# L2: Schema with column names
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Performance Overview',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Cum Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='Volume', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
      ]),
    category='09 cs_summary_table L2: Named Columns')
(cum_ret, volume, close)

# L3: Mean aggregation with schema
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Average Risk Metrics',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Daily Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(title='Volume', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI 14', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='10 cs_summary_table L3: Mean Agg')
(daily_ret, volume, rsi_14)

# L4: max_assets with schema
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    max_assets=2,
    title='Top 2 Assets',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI 14', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='11 cs_summary_table L4: Max Assets')
(close, rsi_14)

# L5: Comprehensive multi-column with schema
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Comprehensive View',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='Cum Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='SMA 20', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='SMA 50', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI 14', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='12 cs_summary_table L5: Comprehensive')
(close, cum_ret, sma_20, sma_50, rsi_14)

# L6: With schema=TableReportSchema — typed columns with formatting
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      title='Schema-Typed Metrics',
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='Cum Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI 14', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='13 cs_summary_table L6: Schema')
(close, cum_ret, rsi_14)

# L7: Transposed with schema — metrics as rows, assets as columns
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    transpose=True,
    title='Transposed: Metrics as Rows',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='Cum Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI 14', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='14 cs_summary_table L7: Transpose')
(close, cum_ret, rsi_14)

# ========================================================================
# AXIS VALUE FORMAT COVERAGE LAYOUTS
# ========================================================================

# L15: summary_table with CardRenderType.PercentFormat
avg_monthly_ret = sma(daily_ret, 21)
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='15 summary_table L8: CardRenderType Percent',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Return Metrics (CardRenderType)',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['Mean Return', 'Best Day', 'Worst Day'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(daily_ret, daily_ret, daily_ret)

# L16: summary_table with CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='16 summary_table L9: CardRenderType Monetary',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Price Levels (CardRenderType)',
      row_size=2, col_size=2,
      row_headers=['Close', 'SMA 20'],
      col_headers=['Last', 'Average'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(close, close, sma_20, sma_20)

# L17: cs_summary_table with CardRenderType.IntegerFormat
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Volume & Count Metrics (CardRenderType)',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Volume', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI 14', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
      ]),
    category='17 cs_summary_table L8: CardRenderType Integer')
(volume, rsi_14, close)

# ========================================================================
# CS_SUMMARY_TABLE — AGG DIVERSITY (16 values)
# ========================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Sum'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Min,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Min'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Max,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Max'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Median'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Std,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Std'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Count'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.First,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=First'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.All,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=All'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Any,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Any'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.CountDistinct,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=CountDistinct'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Kurtosis,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Kurtosis'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Mode,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Mode'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Product,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Product'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Quantile,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Quantile'
)(close, rsi_14)

cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Skew,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Skew'

    agg=AggregationType.Var,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[

        ColumnSpec(title='RSI', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
      ]),
    category='AD cs_summary_table agg=Var'
)(close, rsi_14)
